units: mm, g, deg (internal manifest joint convention: q = firmware_deg - 90 with manifest sign)

mass_model.status: provisional-nominal — weigh the real robot and parts (NEEDS-HARDWARE)
mass_model.servo_note: MG90S nominal from manifest/robot.yaml; SG90 is about 9 g
mass_model.battery_note: S3 build pack (B0F3JB59B6, 47 g listing) at the V3 kit's battery_mount envelope — NEEDS-HARDWARE
mass_model.pla_note: solid PLA is 1.24; small upstream parts with default walls/infill assumed ~77 %

walking_rom.note: union of walk / walk_backward / turn_left / turn_right / stand / rest in manifest/motions.yaml

perforation.layout_note: equal-pitch cells along one spherical spiral, one cell per LED of an addressable tape (user request 2026-11-05)

led_tape.inner_offset_note: LED side faces the shell wall; tape PCB ~1.8 mm inside it

perforation.passive_note: cells continue the same spiral below the tape (no LED) to keep spacing constant and the shell light

shell.variant_note: v3-brackets = shell-dome (no mast) screwed from below onto two side brackets that sit on the inner hip-servo ears
shell.hole_skin_note: diamond holes are blind pockets from the outside leaving 0.3 mm of the inner wall (user request 2026-11-05)
shell.size_note: 2026-11-05 LED spiral: R=98/t=1.2 fails (CoM +12 mm); R=106/t=1.0 passes static with tape up to 20 g/m

bracket.ear_top_note: MG90S/SG90 flange thickness from the upstream servo model
bracket.screw_note: replace the two inner hip-servo ear screws per side with ones 3 mm longer (bracket foot 3 mm)
bracket.lug_screw_note: M2 x 8 self-tapping, driven upward through the counterbored tab (3.5 mm seat) into the lug
bracket.stem_note: stem/tab stay within xc +-5/6.5: walk drives R2 to hip -10 deg and the knee servo then reaches |x| = 10.4

body.note: Loftwork V3 frame kit adapted for the APS carrier (reference/frame-and-cover_261105). Legs unchanged, hip axes at the kit datums.

electronics.name: carrier-components
electronics.note: S3 SuperMini, PCA9685 hub, LM2596, OLED, plugs inside the head; mass estimated, box only for CoM/protection
